Description: Caster acquires complete understanding of any bone damage, including the tools and methods required for healing. Caster does not receive the skill or power to perform the cure
Allows caster to mend one simple fracture (not compound fracture, shatters, joint damage, etc.). Recovery time is 1 day. Will not work on skull fractures
Allows caster to repair all the cartilage around one joint. Recovery time is one day
As Minor Fracture Repair, except caster can also repair compound fractures
Allows caster to prevent the deteriorization of 1 limb (even while severed). Requires the use of Limb Preservation from the Muscle Mastery spell list as well
Allows caster to mend one fracture in a skull (but not a shattered areas). Recovery time is 1-10 days
Allows caster to repair one broken (but not shattered) joint. Recovery time is 1-10 days
As Minor Fracture Repair, except recovery is instantaneous
Allows caster to reattach 1 severed limb. Also requires the use of the other 3 Lay Healer Joining spells to make limb fully functional. Limb is fully functional after 10-100 days
As Cartilage Repair, except recovery is instantaneous
As Major Fracture Repair, except recovery is instantaneous
As Skull Repair, except recovery is instantaneous

Allows caster to transplant a healthy bone. This requires a 1 hour operation. Recovery time is 1-10 days. There is a chance that the target's body will reject the new bone: 10% if bone is from the same race as the target, 50% is the bone is from some other similiar race
Allows caster to repair any 1 broken or shattered bone (even in the skull). This requires a 1 hour operation. Recovery time is 1-10 days
As Joint Repair, except that recovery is instantaneous
As Bone Transplant, except with a recovery time of 1-10 hours
As Shatter Repair, except with a recovery time of 1-10 hours
As Joining, except caster must cast the other 3 Lay Healer Joining True spells and the limb is fully functional in 10 minutes
Allows caster to regenerate 1 section of cartilage in target's body. Recovery time is 1-10 days
Allows caster to regenerate 1 lost bone. Recovery time is 1-10 days

Allows caster to regenerate any part (or all) of a skeleton (including cartilage) in 1-10 days, depending on the severity of the damage. SPECIAL NOTES 1) See Section 7.2 for more on damage and healing. 2) Some spells on this list require an operation to be effective. These spells have the same name as other healing spells (from the Channeling realm) and the GM may decide that the operation is not required. BONE MASTERY
